description: pi-mono shows keybinding hints in the startup banner, not the footer. However, octo_pi's footer currently has no shortcut hints at all. Add a condensed hint line to the footer showing the most important shortcuts: Esc (interrupt), Ctrl+C (exit), /help (commands). Style with dimmed text, right-aligned or centered. This is a simple addition to OctoPi.TUI.Components.Footer.render/2.
title: Footer shortcut hints
